title: PRIVATE TOUR MELBOURNE STANDARD
route: Phillip Island - Maru Koala & Wildlife Park - Penguin Parade - Great Ocean Road - Apollo Bay - 12 Apostles

includes: 4 Nights Accommodation at 3 Star Hotel in City Centre
Private Transportation as per itinerary (12 hours basis)
Entry Ticket to Maru Koala & Animal Park
Entry Ticket to Churchill Island Heritage Farm
Entry Ticket to Penguin Parade - General Viewing
excludes: Extra hour Transport & Tour Guide (pay in cash to driver, AUD50/hour)
Flight Luggage, In-Flight Meal & Airport Tax

itinerary.title: KUL - Arrival Melbourne
activities: Arrival, meet & greet with ARBA driver & guide

itinerary.title: Phillip Island, Wildlife & Farm Tour
activities: Maru Koala & Animal Park (meet Australian wildlife, hand-feed kangaroos & wallabies)
San Remo Pelican Feeding Show (watch wild pelican feeding, photo stop)
Churchill Island Heritage Farm (farm shows — cow milking, sheep shearing, whip cracking)
The Nobbies (cliff-top boardwalks, sunset photo stop)
Penguin Parade — general viewing (world-famous little penguins at sunset)

itinerary.title: Great Ocean Road
activities: Aireys Inlet Lighthouse (iconic lighthouse, coastal views, photo stops)
12 Apostles (iconic Great Ocean Road landmark, photo stop)
Loch Ard Gorge (stunning beach between cliffs, photo stop)

itinerary.title: Free & Easy
activities: OR choose from add-on options (private day tour)

expect.title: Australian Wildlife
expect.body: Visit and interact with Australian wildlife and experience farming shows such as sheep shearing and cow milking.

expect.title: Scenic Coastal Road
expect.body: Stunning coastal cliffs, Twelve Apostles, rainforest walks, seaside towns and wildlife along Australia's most scenic road trip.

expect.title: Transport/Guide
expect.body: Malaysian driver/tour guide living in Melbourne. Private Transport as per itinerary. Extra Hour surcharge $50/hour (must be paid in cash to driver).

expect.title: 3 Star Hotel
expect.body: Hotel in City Centre (Free Tram Zone). Double or Triple Room. 4 Star Hotel or Apart'hotel upgrade available on request.

expect.title: Food Arrangement
expect.body: Meal stops at Halal Certified/Friendly Restaurants. Asian, Middle Eastern, Western options.

expect.title: Visa Application Assistance
expect.body: Free online session or physical appointment at our office. AUD $20 application fee to Australian Immigration by own expense. Approval is subject to Australian Immigration's decision.

expect.title: Arrival / Departure
expect.body: Early Arrival or Late Departure time that requires additional tour must choose from Private Day Tour Add-On Options.

entries: All prices are valid for 24 hours after quotation submission.
The price is for 2 or 3 persons per room.
Late Booking Surcharge will apply for bookings made less than 45 days before the departure date.
Private Transportation & Driving Guide is based on specified total hour basis as per itinerary. AUD50/hour will be charged for every extra hour usage. Payment must be paid in cash.
Itinerary, price, flight is subject to change accordingly.
Final itinerary and hotel arrangements 14 days before trip.
Please check with our staff on the trip validity or before booking any connecting domestic flights.
Special Event Date Surcharge (e.g. Christmas / New Year / Chinese New Year) not included – please enquire prior booking.

deposit.text: prior to arrival for full payment

surcharge.title: Surcharge — Accommodation Upgrade & Peak Season
notes: *Note: Special Event Date Surcharge (e.g. Christmas / New Year / Chinese New Year) not included – please enquire prior booking.

entries.name: Half/Full-Day City Tour
entries.includes: Queen Victoria Market, DFO South Wharf, Flinders Station & Federation Square (Degraves Street & Flinders Lane, Princes Bridge, Hosier Lane), Brighton Beach Bathing Boxes, Shrine of Remembrance
entries.duration: Half-Day Private Transport (5 hours) — may only cover half of the tour, customer to choose · Full-Day Private Transport (10 hours)

entries.name: Puffing Billy & Dandenong Ranges
entries.includes: Puffing Billy Steam Train: Belgrave - Lakeside Station (ride iconic heritage steam train), Dandenong/Royal Botanic Garden, Sassafras Village, Skyhigh Lookout (Vehicle Entrance Included)

entries.name: Mornington Peninsula
entries.includes: Pure Peninsula Honey, Enchanted Garden Adventure (adventure park: garden mazes, tube slides, canopy walk), Red Hill Lavender Farm (seasonal), Sorrento Ocean Beach, Cape Schanck Boardwalk

entries.name: Winter Snow Trip
entries.includes: Mt Buller / Mt Baw Baw (Winter Sports: Skiing, Snowboarding, Tobogganing, etc) OR Lake Mountain (Snow Play, Tobogganing); Vehicle Entrance Ticket & Tyre Snow Chains Included
